reconstructed_captions.1: The person begins to tear the paper into several pieces.
reconstructed_captions.2: The paper is torn further into smaller and smaller pieces.
reconstructed_captions.3: All the torn pieces of the paper are gathered together in the person's hands.
reconstructed_captions.4: The small, torn pieces are crumpled into a tight ball.
reconstructed_captions.5: The person makes a magical gesture and begins to unfold the crumpled ball.
reconstructed_captions.6: The paper is unfolded to reveal it is miraculously whole again, with the drawing intact.
